verdict_text: NO. The plan never explicitly verifies that all three checkpoints have the same tensor-name set; equal counts plus one-way equality checks outside the MLP set do not establish key-set equality. Its `\d+` patterns also treat MLP tensors from any layer number as mergeable rather than restricting the required set to layers 0–15. This violates Required Result 1 and could allow unexpected or mismatched tensor names to escape the precondition check.
